intro: Between late April and mid-May 2026, five sandbox-escape vulnerabilities were documented, led by CVE-2026-8954 and CVE-2026-8959, both carrying a CVSS score of 9.6. Additional critical flaws included CVE-2026-5752 (CVSS 9.3), while CVE-2026-8573 and CVE-2026-8577 were rated high at 8.8. The technology, artificial intelligence, financial services, and government sectors were most affected globally, with three critical and two high-severity CVEs in the mix.
